finding: Scope guard compares product reference to HEAD rather than the candidate/index tree; staged product changes can be invisible before commit.
Content validation still runs on the mutable working tree. Working-tree==index is not byte identity under filters, encodings, LFS, sparse/skip-worktree, untracked or ignored inputs.
WPNO_GATE_SELFTEST can replace the complete production gate with a trivial self-test; production environment is not hermetically sanitized.
WPNO_STAGEDTREE_TEST_MODE/WPNO_STAGEDTREE_GATE_CMD can advance the branch under a synthetic gate; the attestation is TEST_MODE but the broker can still return GREEN.
The branch ref is updated before the V2 attestation is durably written and verified. An attestation failure can leave HEAD advanced without a valid attestation.
GREEN_PENDING_GATECODE_REVIEW is committed to the active branch but the CLI returns failure; the state is ambiguous and product work is not hard-blocked.
HMAC is in the same trust domain as the product agent, can be redirected by environment variable, and is auto-created. It is not an independent signing root.
An expected active gate script that is missing is only logged as SKIP; the gate remains fail-open.
The candidate tree can modify validators and tests that judge it. Detection only produces PENDING and does not provide an external trusted oracle.
Attestation does not bind the full execution environment and external inputs: runtime, lockfiles, PATH, PYTHONPATH, locale, timezone, env, off-git manifests, databases, seeds and timeouts.
Direct git commit/commit-tree/update-ref can bypass the broker and ordinary hooks; unattested commits are not yet hard-excluded from the product chain.
V1 records can remain a current fallback trust path. Legacy evidence is not cleanly separated from current-policy eligibility.
Cryptographic validity, policy freshness and product eligibility are conflated. Durability tests accept ATTESTATION_STALE as equivalent to green.
The alleged append-only ledger test is only a presence test and does not detect truncation, replacement or mutation of prior entries.
Core staged-tree tests use a lightweight injected BADVALUE gate, not the complete production gate and independent production oracle.
Gate lifecycle registry covers only two phases; the complete phase contract is not fail-closed and the derived manifest is not authoritative.
Design documentation contradicts implementation: detached materialized-tree gate is documented although the final code uses working-tree==index in the live repo.
Red-team summaries claim closure while verification artifacts still contain open or partial findings; supersession and final evidence are inconsistent.
The review bundle lacks the actual production V2 record and direct copies of two core scripts; the synthetic example has missing schema hashes.
Production-sensitive paths and behavior are controlled by inherited environment variables such as WPNO_CI_REPO, WPNO_ATTEST_DIR, WPNO_ATTEST_HMAC_KEY and gate settings.
Working-tree contents can mutate during the gate and be restored before the final index check, allowing a mixed-state validation; locks are only cooperative.
commit-tree/update-ref bypass commit signing, commit-msg rules, ordinary hook side effects, session handoff and other process controls unless explicitly replicated.
Candidate registry uses dynamic HEAD and ad-hoc parsing/fallbacks; it is not an immutable, schema-validated promotion record.
Gate/test/schema hashes are truncated and omit registry, policy, toolchain and external-input state.
Absent-but-listed constitutional and schema artifacts reduce auditability and leave key rules embedded only in code/prose.
